description: Fetch a finished Argus run report: money-guard outcome, verdict counts, per-probe verdicts, and the proven / violations_found / not_established lists. Requires the run id from argus_run_simulation or argus_run_engine. Treat proven violations as evidence you can show the user; 'not established' means the probe could not decide — it is not a pass.

run_id.description: Run id returned by argus_run_simulation / argus_run_engine

name: argus_get_run_report
